title: Synthesis, characterization, and iron supplementation effects of egg yolk phosphopeptide‐ferrous chelate
venue: The Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture
abstract: Iron‐deficiency anemia (IDA) persists as a global public health burden, urging the development of high‐efficacy iron supplements with improved bioavailability and stability. Egg yolk phosphopeptides (EYPPs) possess excellent metal‐chelating potential due to their abundant functional groups, making them ideal carriers for iron fortification.
